testCase:
G-004: Sort select reorders a table
Goal: Sort the products by price from high to low and check that the Hesketh Blender is first.
STEP 1: Navigate to /gopro/index.html#s4
STEP 2: Select "Price (high to low)" in the "Sort by" dropdown
STEP 3: Verify that 'First row: Hesketh Blender' is visible

plan.title: G-004: Sort products by descending price

steps.note: Verify Hesketh Blender is reported as the first row.

reasoning: This test checks that sorting products by price from high to low puts Hesketh Blender first. The plan selects the requested sort option and verifies the exact first-row text supplied by the case.
